columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Source order key; unique non-null; audit/join only.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Session key; audit/join only, never a predictor.

columns.name: customer_unique_id
columns.description: Persistent customer key used for CV grouping.

columns.name: prediction_timestamp
columns.description: Checkout cutoff anchor (order_purchase_timestamp); splitting only.

columns.name: order_status
columns.description: Final source status; audit only, never a predictor.

columns.name: lead_days
columns.description: (delivered - purchase) seconds / 86400; delivered + strictly positive.

columns.name: review_score_min
columns.description: Minimum valid score 1-5 across supplied reviews; null if none.

columns.name: is_detractor
columns.description: 1 if review_score_min <= 2; 0 if >= 3; null if no valid score.

columns.name: eligible_regression
columns.description: Delivered + valid positive lead_days + valid prediction time + resolved group.

columns.name: eligible_classification
columns.description: Valid review target + valid prediction time + resolved group; delivery not required.

columns.name: regression_exclusion_reason
columns.description: Ordered reason codes for regression ineligibility.

columns.name: classification_exclusion_reason
columns.description: Ordered reason codes for classification ineligibility.

columns.name: regression_label_available_at
columns.description: Customer delivery timestamp for valid regression outcomes.

columns.name: review_latest_observed_at
columns.description: Max valid answer timestamp across contributing valid reviews.

columns.name: review_count
columns.description: Number of review records for the order.

columns.name: seller_id_missing
columns.description: Any item seller_id missing -> complete seller set unknown.

columns.name: n_items
columns.description: Count of item rows per order.
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: has_items
columns.description: int(n_items > 0).
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: n_products
columns.description: Distinct non-null product_id among items.
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: n_sellers
columns.description: Distinct non-null seller_id among items.
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: n_categories
columns.description: Distinct resolved translated English categories, excluding Unknown.
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: total_price
columns.description: Sum item price, each item once.
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: total_freight
columns.description: Sum item freight_value, each item once.

columns.name: freight_ratio
columns.description: total_freight / total_price; null if denominator <= 0 or either missing.
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: freight_ratio_missing
columns.description: int(freight_ratio is null).
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: total_weight_g
columns.description: Sum product_weight_g; null if any item weight invalid/missing or no items.
columns.availability_assumption: checkout-complete simulation: item/payment/catalogue snapshot availability assumed; payments have no event timestamps and catalogue attributes have no historical versions

columns.name: total_volume_cm3
columns.description: Sum length*height*width; null if any item volume unknown or no items.

columns.name: weight_missing_fraction
columns.description: Invalid/unknown item weights / n_items; null if no items.

columns.name: volume_missing_fraction

columns.name: primary_category
columns.description: English category of the deterministic primary item.

columns.name: category_missing_fraction
columns.description: Fraction of items lacking a resolved category; null if no items.

columns.name: customer_state

columns.name: primary_seller_state
columns.description: Seller state of the primary item; Unknown for absent/unresolved.

columns.name: distance_km_max

columns.name: distance_missing_fraction
columns.description: Distinct sellers with unresolved distance / n_sellers; null if no sellers.

columns.description: Fraction of distinct sellers whose state differs from customer state.
